relations.subject: James Ishmael Ford
relations.evidence: Ford began his Zen studies in 1968 at the Berkeley Zen Center under the direction of Mel Weitsman, later Weitsman, Roshi.

relations.subject: James Ishmael Ford
relations.evidence: He was ordained unsui and received Dharma transmission from the late Jiyu Kennett Roshi .

relations.subject: James Ishmael Ford
relations.evidence: Ford pursued Zen koan introspection for nearly twenty years in the Sanbo Kyodan tradition with John Tarrant Roshi, with whom he completed formal training and from whom he received Inka Shomei

relations.subject: James Ishmael Ford
relations.evidence: He is the co-founder and first abbot of Boundless Way Zen

relations.subject: James Ishmael Ford
relations.evidence: He then established the Empty Moon Zen Network, a network of Zen Centers in California, Washington state, and Pennsylvania.
